'''Clan Detta''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence prior to the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Among the clan were two brothers, [[Suvar Detta|Suvar]] and [[Cham Detta]], who fought at the side of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s invasion of the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]].

==History==
Two members of Clan Detta, the brothers [[Cham Detta|Cham]] and [[Suvar Detta]], joined the ranks of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] under the leadership of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Protectors">Though neither Cham Detta or Suvar Detta are specifically referred to as Mandalorian Protectors during the course of ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', [[Abel G. Peña]]'s [[Star Wars Insider]] article [[The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors|''The History of the Mandalorians'']] states that the Mandalorian troops Boba Fett led during the Yuuzhan Vong War were Mandalorian Protectors.</ref> The Detta brothers were among a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to witness the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s entrance to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], and subsequently aided Fett in legitimizing the appearance of the Mandalorians working for the Yuuzhan Vong by covertly [[Battle of Birgis|assaulting]] the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] at [[Birgis]]. In reality, the Mandalorians were acting as double-agents against the Yuuzhan Vong, and Cham Detta was ordered to get a local [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] offworld under the cover of a false pursuit, in order to allow [[Gender/Legends|her]] to deliver the intelligence the Mandalorians had gathered back to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="APM" />

Three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the war, both Suvar and Cham Detta took part in the [[Battle of New Holgha]]. There, the Mandalorians were confronted with an opportunity to rescue a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] from the Yuuzhan Vong, who in turn could pass along their intelligence to the New Republic and verify its authenticity; the previous attempt to turn over intelligence had been ignored due to the belief that the hostile Mandalorians were attempting to spread misinformation. Aiding the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as [[Kubariet]], the Mandalorians were forced into a skirmish with the Yuuzhan Vong [[subaltern]], [[Bur'lorr]]. The Detta brothers engaged the [[Warrior caste|Yuuzhan Vong warrior]] in a close-quarters fight together with the other Mandalorians, and it was Suvar who decapitated the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior's]] [[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] [[amphistaff]]. Bur'lorr was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Crushgaunt/Legends|crushgaunt]]-covered [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of of their comrade [[Goran Beviin]].<ref name="APM" />

More than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, in [[41 ABY]], Cham Detta had become the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] of the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Detta was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via the appearance of the Detta brothers, Cham and Suvar, in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]. Cham Detta made another appearance in Traviss' later novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', published [[February 26]], [[2008]].
